column4: Identical camera and cathedral stage as the first reference with the floor hatch open. The living librarian (second reference, barefoot) climbs up out of the hatch onto the stage boards, one hand and knee on the edge, looking out toward the viewer. No strings, no text.

Identical locked view and the same rows of coal hoods as the reference, but every hood has turned sideways and back over the shoulder, as if all looking at someone behind them; faces stay fully hidden in black shadow inside the hoods. No text.

Identical camera and cathedral aisle as the first reference, looking toward the exit doors. The living librarian (second reference) walks away from the viewer down the center of the aisle, seen from behind, her long orange hair down her back. In the pews on both sides, coal-hooded congregants sit hunched over ledgers, faces hidden. No strings, no text.

Continue the first reference: identical camera, congregant, pew, ledger and wall scroll, but the coal hood has slid back off the head, revealing a bald white porcelain doll face with blank painted eyes and clear seams and stitch lines running across the forehead and cheeks like a mended mask. The hand keeps writing tally marks. No text lettering.

Continue the reference: identical camera, the same living human hand and white cuff, but the fist has now opened by itself into a relaxed open palm facing up, five fingers spread a little, natural skin, nothing in the hand. Flat ivory background. No text.
